summary_1line: Yudhishthira defends keeping the exile vow after the dice loss, while Bhima angrily urges immediate war to reclaim their kingdom.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the forest camp, Bhima stands furious with clenched fists while Yudhishthira sits calm yet pained, defending his vow before the exiled brothers.
Bhima burns with rage, gripping his hands as he recalls wanting to burn Yudhishthira’s dice-playing hands in the Kuru assembly.
The Pandava brothers sit in austere exile among dark woods as Bhima argues for war and Yudhishthira gazes downward in troubled restraint.
